## Baseline Trait Data  
```{r}
baseline_codebook <- sprintf("%s/baseline_items.xlsx", wd) %>% 
  readxl::read_xlsx(sheet = "codebook")
baseline <- sprintf("%s/data/baseline/baseline_5.20.19.csv", wd) %>% 
  read_csv() %>%
  filter(!row_number() %in% c(1,2))
```

```{r}
cols <- baseline_codebook$`New #`
baseline_facets <- baseline %>% select(SID, one_of(cols)) %>%
  gather(key = item, value = t_value, -SID, na.rm = T) %>%
  left_join(baseline_codebook %>% select(item = `New #`, Reverse, Facet)) %>%
  filter(grepl("BFI", item)) %>%
  separate(item, c("inventory", "Trait", "item"), sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(t_value = as.numeric(t_value), 
         t_value = ifelse(Reverse == -1, reverse.code(-1, t_value, mini = 1, maxi = 5), t_value)) %>%
  group_by(Trait, Facet, SID) %>%
  summarize(t_value = mean(t_value, na.rm = T))
```

## Baseline State Data
### Big 5 Item-Level Data  
```{r}
state_codebook <- sprintf("%s/ESM_items.xlsx", wd) %>% readxl::read_xlsx(., sheet = "codebook")

load(sprintf("%s/data/esm/clean_data_w1_2019-05-10.RData", wd))

# make the long form data wide and keep only participants where N >= P
BFI.wide <- BFI %>% filter(!is.na(item) & type == "BFI2") %>%  
  select(-trial_index, -trait, -facet, -answer) %>%
  spread(key = item, value = responses2) %>%
  mutate_at(vars(A1:O9), funs(as.numeric)) %>%
  group_by(SID) %>%
  filter(n() >= 15)

# small workaround for participants with no variability. Given the tiny amount of jitter,
# they won't correlate with anything, but everything will, at least, run
jitter_fun <- function(df){
  z <- apply(df, 2, function(x)sum(!is.na(x)))
  df <- df[,z > 1]
  sd_fun <- function(x){if(sd(x, na.rm = T) == 0) jitter(x, amount = runif(1,0,.05)) else x}
  df2 <- data.frame(apply(df, 2, sd_fun))
  colnames(df2) <- colnames(df2)
  return(df2)
}

# Create a count variable for each participant
BFI.wide <- 
  BFI.wide %>%
  group_by(SID) %>%
  arrange(SID, Date, Hour, Minute) %>%
  mutate(all_beeps = seq(1, n(),1))

# add the teeny jitter if there's no variability
BFI.wide <- BFI.wide %>%
  select(SID, all_beeps, A1:O9) %>%
  group_by(SID) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(data2 = map(data, possibly(jitter_fun, NA_real_))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(data2)) %>%
  unnest(data2, .drop = T) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(SID = as.character(SID)) %>%
  full_join(BFI.wide %>% select(SID, Date, Hour, Minute, Day, HourBlock, all_beeps))

BFI.wide %>% 
  filter(SID == "032901") %>% 
  select(SID, Date, Hour, A1, A2:A9, A10:A12, C1, C2:A9, C10:A12, 
         E1, E2:E9, E10:A12, N1, N2:N9, N10:N12, O1, O2:O9, O10:O12) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 0) %>%
  write.csv(., file = sprintf("%s/data/sample_raw.csv", wd), row.names = F, na = "")
```

### BFI Facet-Level Data  
```{r}
# save a vector of the short facet names for later
short.facets <- state_codebook %>% 
  filter(type == "BFI2") %>% 
  select(Facet, shrtFacet) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  separate(shrtFacet, c("trait", "shrtFacet2"), remove = F)

# create a data frame that has facet level, instead of item level, data
# also reverse code before compositing the items (within person, within time) into facets
(BFI.facet <- BFI.wide %>%
  gather(key = item, value = value, A1:O9, na.rm = T) %>%
  left_join(state_codebook %>% select(item = Item, trait = Trait, facet = Facet, reverse)) %>%
  mutate(value = ifelse(is.na(reverse), value, as.numeric(mapvalues(round(value), 1:5, 5:1)))) %>%
  group_by(SID, all_beeps, facet, trait, Date, Hour, HourBlock, Day) %>%
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(facet)) %>%
  mutate(value = ifelse(is.nan(value) == T, NA_real_, value), # if all are NA, it spits out NaN, not NA
         facet2 = mapvalues(facet, short.facets$Facet, short.facets$shrtFacet)) %>%
  select(SID, all_beeps, facet2, value, Date, Hour, HourBlock, Day) %>%
  spread(key = facet2, value = value)) # make facets wide again

BFI.facet %>% 
  filter(SID == "032901") %>% 
  select(SID, Date, Hour, A_Cmpn:O_IntCur) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 0) %>%
  write.csv(., file = sprintf("%s/data/facet_raw.csv", wd), row.names = F, na = "")
```

### Big 5 Trait-Level Data  
```{r}
BFI.trait <- BFI.wide %>%
  gather(key = item, value = value, A1:O9, na.rm = T) %>%
  left_join(state_codebook %>% select(item = Item, trait = Trait, facet = Facet, reverse)) %>%
  mutate(value = ifelse(is.na(reverse), value, as.numeric(mapvalues(round(value), 1:5, 5:1)))) %>%
  group_by(SID, all_beeps, trait, Date, Hour, HourBlock, Day) %>%
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(trait)) %>%
  mutate(value = ifelse(is.nan(value) == T, NA_real_, value),
         trait =  substr(trait, 1, 1)) %>%
  select(SID, all_beeps, trait, value, Date, Hour, HourBlock, Day) %>%
  spread(key = trait, value = value) # make facets wide again
```


### Multiple Imputation
```{r}
set.seed(27)
BFI.mi <- data.frame(unclass(BFI.facet %>% select(-(Date:Day)))) %>%
  amelia(., m = 1, ts = "all_beeps", cs = "SID") 

BFI.mi <- BFI.mi$imputations[[1]] %>%
  full_join(BFI.facet %>% select(SID, all_beeps, Date:Day))

BFI.mi %>% 
  filter(SID == "032901") %>% 
  select(SID, Date, Hour, A_Cmpn:O_IntCur) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 0) %>%
  write.csv(., file = sprintf("%s/data/facet_mi.csv", wd), row.names = F, na = "")

state_facets <- BFI.mi %>%
  group_by(SID) %>% 
  summarise_at(vars(A_Cmpn:O_IntCur), mean, na.rm = T) %>%
  gather(Facet, s_value, -SID) %>%
  separate(Facet, c("Trait", "item"), sep = "_", remove = F) %>%
  mutate(Facet = mapvalues(Facet, state_codebook$shrtFacet, state_codebook$Facet, warn_missing = F)) %>%
  select(-item)

BFI.trait.mi <- BFI.mi %>%
  gather(item, value, A_Cmpn:O_IntCur)  %>%
  separate(item, c("trait", "item")) %>%
  group_by(SID, trait, all_beeps, Date, Hour, HourBlock, Day) %>% 
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = T)) %>%
  spread(trait,value)
```

```{r}
tab_fun <- function(x){
  tmp <- broom::tidy(x) %>%
    mutate(term = mapvalues(term, c("sd_(Intercept).SID", "sd_Observation.Residual"),
                            c("tau_00", "sigma")))
  confint(x, oldNames = F) %>% data.frame %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    mutate(term = mapvalues(term, "sd_(Intercept)|SID", "tau_00")) %>%
    setNames(c("term", "lower", "upper")) %>%
    full_join(tmp)
}
```

## Within-Person Structure  
### Prepare Data  
```{r}
BFI.trait <- BFI.trait %>% left_join(sit.wide) %>% ungroup()
BFI.trait.mi <- BFI.trait.mi %>% left_join(sit.wide) %>% ungroup()
BFI.mi <- BFI.mi %>% left_join(sit.wide) %>% ungroup()
BFI.facet <- BFI.facet %>% left_join(sit.wide) %>% ungroup()
```


```{r, eval = F}
new_path_fun <- function(model, wave, comp, mi){
  if(!"data" %in% list.files(wd)) {dir.create(sprintf("%s/data", wd))}
  if(!"results" %in% list.files(wd)) {dir.create(sprintf("%s/results", wd))}
  file <- sprintf("%s_%s_%s_w%s", model, comp, mi, wave)
  if(!file %in% list.files(sprintf("%s/data", wd))) {dir.create(sprintf("%s/data/%s", wd, file))}
  if(!file %in% list.files(sprintf("%s/results", wd))) {dir.create(sprintf("%s/results/%s", wd, file))}
}

# function to create data files for each person
write_fun <- function(sid, model, Wave, comp, mi){
  if(comp == "bf"){if(mi == "mi"){x <- BFI.trait.mi} else{x <- BFI.trait}}
  if(comp == "facet"){if(mi == "mi"){x <- BFI.mi} else{x <- BFI.facet}}
  if(comp == "bf"){cols <- c("E", "A", "C", "N", "O")} else{cols <- short.facets$shrtFacet}
  if(sid %in% (BFI.mi)$SID){
  x <- x %>% 
    filter(SID == sid) %>%
    arrange(SID, Day, HourBlock) %>%
    select(one_of(c(cols, model))) %>%
    data.frame
  
  if(model != "null"){
    if(sd(x[,model], na.rm = T) == 0){
      replace <- c(0,1)[!0:1 %in% unique(x[,model])]
      x[sample(1:nrow(x), 2), model] <- replace
    }
    if(any(table(x[,model]) == 1)){
      replace <- c(0,1)[which(table(x[,model]) <= 1)]
      x[sample(1:nrow(x), 2), model] <- replace
    }
  }
  write.csv(x, file = sprintf("%s/data/%s_%s_%s_w%s/%s.csv", wd, model, comp, mi, Wave, sid), row.names = F)
  }
}

dat.wide <- BFI.mi %>% full_join(sit.wide)

# write files for each person for gimme
crossing(model = c("null", "lonely", "prcrst"),
         wave = 1,
         mi = c("mi", "raw"),
         comp = c("bf", "facet")) %>%

  full_join(crossing(SID = unique((dat.wide %>% group_by(SID) %>% summarize(n = n()) %>% filter(n > 15))$SID), wave = 1)) %>%
  mutate(data = pmap(list(SID, model, wave, comp, mi), write_fun))
```

### Run Models  
```{r, eval = F}
# function to run gimme for different models
gimme_fun <- function(model, wave, comp, mi){
  print(model)
  fit <- gimme(         # can use "gimme" or "gimmeSEM"
  data = sprintf("%s/data/%s_%s_%s_w%s", wd, model,comp, mi, wave),  # source directory where your data are 
  out = sprintf("%s/results/%s_%s_%s_w%s", wd, model, comp, mi, wave),# output directory where you'd like your output to go
  sep = ",",           # how data are separated. "" for space; "," for comma, "/t" for tab-delimited
  header = TRUE,          # TRUE or FALSE, is there a header
  ar = TRUE,          # TRUE (default) or FALSE, start with autoregressive paths open
  plot = FALSE,        # TRUE (default) or FALSE, generate plots
  subgroup = FALSE,   # TRUE or FALSE (default), cluster individuals based on similarities in effects
  paths = NULL,       # option to list paths that will be group-level (semi-confirmatory)
  groupcutoff = .75  # the proportion that is considered the majority at the group level
)
  save(fit, file = sprintf("%s/results/gimme_%s_%s_%s_w%s.RData", wd, model, comp, mi, wave))
  return(TRUE)
}

# data frame for keeping things tidy
gimme_nested <- crossing(

  ) %>%
  filter(model == "lonely" & comp == "bf") %>%
  mutate(gimme = pmap(list(model, wave, comp, mi), gimme_fun))
```

### Load Results  
```{r}
var_fun <- function(model, comp){
  if (comp == "bf"){if(model == "null"){c("E", "A", "C", "N", "O")} else{c("E", "A", "C", "N", "O", model)}}
  else {if(model == "null"){short.facets$shrtFacet} else{c(short.facets$shrtFacet, model)}}
}

load_fun <- function(model, wave,  comp, mi, vars){
  sprintf("%s/results/gimme/%s_%s_%s_w%s/indivPathEstimates.csv", wd, model, comp, mi, wave) %>% 
    read_csv() %>%
    mutate(type = ifelse(grepl("lag", dv) | grepl("lag", iv), "Lagged", "Contemporaneous"),
           file = as.character(file)) %>%
    filter(level != "group") %>%
    select(SID = file, from = iv, to = dv, value = beta, type) %>%
    full_join(crossing(SID = .$SID, from = vars, to = vars, type = "Contemporaneous") %>%
    full_join(crossing(SID = .$SID, from = paste(vars, "lag", sep=""), to = vars, type = "Lagged"))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(type)) %>%
    mutate(value = ifelse(is.na(value), 0, value)) %>%
    arrange(SID) 
}

subs <- list.files(sprintf("%s/results/gimme/null_facet_mi_w1/individual", wd)) %>% 
  str_remove_all(., "[a-z A-Z.]")

gimme_nested <- crossing(
  model = c("null", "lonely", "prcrst"),
  wave = 1,
  comp = c("bf", "facet"),
  mi = "mi") %>%
  mutate(vars = map2(model, comp, var_fun)) %>%
  mutate(fit = pmap(list(model, wave, comp, mi, vars), load_fun)) %>%
  unnest(fit, .drop = T) %>%
  select(-vars) %>%
  group_by(model, SID, wave, type, comp, mi) %>%
  nest() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = data)


PDC_fun <- function(df, model, vars){
  df <- df %>% 
    # full_join(crossing(from = paste(vars, "lag", sep = ""), to = vars)) %>%
    mutate(from = str_remove_all(from, "lag")) %>%
    mutate_at(vars(from, to), ~factor(., levels = vars)) %>%
    spread(to, value) %>% 
    mutate_at(vars(-from), ~ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)) %>%
    unclass() %>% data.frame() 
  rownames(df) <- df$from
  df <- df %>% select(-from)
}

PCC_fun <- function(df, model, vars){
  df <- df %>% 
    # full_join(crossing(from = vars, to = vars)) %>%
    mutate_at(vars(from, to), ~factor(., levels = vars)) %>%
    arrange(from) %>%
    spread(to, value) %>% 
    mutate_at(vars(-from), ~ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)) %>%
    unclass() %>% data.frame()
  rownames(df) <- df$from
  df <- df %>% select(-from)
  df <- as.matrix(df)
  PCC <- apply(simplify2array(list(df, t(df))), 1:2, mean)
  diag(PCC) <- NA
  PCC <- data.frame(PCC)
}

long_fun <- function(df){df %>% mutate(from = rownames(.)) %>% gather(key = to, value = value, -from)}

centrality_fun <- function(x){
  centrality_auto(data.frame(x))$node.centrality %>%
    data.frame() %>%
    mutate(var = rownames(.))
}

gimme_nested <- gimme_nested %>%
  mutate(vars = map2(model, comp, var_fun),
         PDC = pmap(list(Lagged, model, vars), PDC_fun),
         PCC = pmap(list(Contemporaneous, model, vars), PCC_fun),
         Lagged = map(PDC, long_fun),
         Contemporaneous = map(PCC, long_fun),
         centrality = map(Contemporaneous, centrality_fun))
```

### Prediction Plots  
```{r}
pro_plot_fun <- function(df, SID){
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(model = mapvalues(model, c("lonely", "prcrst"), c("Loneliness", "Procrastination"))) %>%
    filter(model == "Procrastination") 
    p <- df %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x = facet, y = value)) +
      geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0), linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_point(aes(size = abs(value), color =  comp), shape = "square") +
      scale_size_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), range = c(2, 6)) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "white")) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-.75, .75), breaks = seq(-.5, .5, .5)) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Relationship Strength", title = sprintf("Participant %s", SID)) +
      coord_flip() +
      facet_grid(trait~model, scale = "free_y", switch = "y") +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(legend.position = "none",
            axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2), color = "black"),
            # axis.text.y = element_text(size = rel(2)),
            axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2)),
            legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2)),
            legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2)),
            strip.background = element_rect(fill = "black"),
            strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.5), color = "white"),
            strip.placement = "outside",
            plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2), hjust = .5))
}

gimme_nested_pro <- gimme_nested %>%
  filter(model == "prcrst") %>%
  group_by(SID) %>% filter(n() == 2) %>%
  unnest(Contemporaneous) %>%
  mutate(value = ifelse(is.na(value), 0, value)) %>%
  filter(from %in% c("lonely", "prcrst") | to %in% c("lonely", "prcrst")) %>%
  mutate(dir =  ifelse(from == model, "from", "to"),
         trait = ifelse(from == model, to, from)) %>%
  separate(trait, c("trait", "facet"), sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(facet = ifelse(is.na(facet), "Overall", facet),
         facet = factor(facet, levels = c(short.facets$shrtFacet2, "Overall")),
         trait = factor(trait, levels = c("E", "A", "C", "N", "O"))) %>%
  filter(dir == "to") %>%
  group_by(SID, mi) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(c_plot = map2(data, SID, pro_plot_fun),
         all_plot = map(c_plot, function(p){p + geom_line(aes(group = model)) + scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "black"))}))

library(animation)

loop.animate <- function() {
    lapply(1:nrow(gimme_nested_pro), function(i) {
        print(gimme_nested_pro$c_plot[[i]])
    })
}
```

## P-factor v. R-factor  
```{r}
r_fun <- function(x){
  y <- x %>% select(-SID) %>% as.matrix()
  rownames(y) <- x$SID
  cor(y, use = "pairwise")
}
set.seed(14)
nested.strctr <- BFI.mi %>%
  select(-(Date:Day)) %>%
  mutate(type = "MI") %>%
  full_join(BFI.facet %>% 
              select(SID, all_beeps, A_Cmpn:O_IntCur) %>% 
              mutate(type = "Facets")) %>%
  group_by(SID, type) %>%
  summarize_at(vars(-all_beeps), list(mean), na.rm = T) %>%
  full_join(baseline_facets %>% ungroup() %>%
              mutate(Facet = mapvalues(Facet, short.facets$Facet, short.facets$shrtFacet)) %>% 
              select(-Trait) %>% spread(Facet, t_value) %>%
              mutate(type = "Trait")) %>%
  arrange(SID) %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(r = map(data, r_fun),
         fa = map2(r, data, ~fa(.x, nfactors = 5, n.obs = nrow(.y), rotate = "oblimin")))

```

### Big 5 Recovery  
```{r}
clean_loadings <- function(x){
  x$loadings %>%
    unclass %>%
    data.frame %>%
    setNames(str_replace(colnames(.), "MR", "F")) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Indicator") %>%
    tbl_df %>%
    gather(key = factor, value = loading, -Indicator) %>%
    separate(Indicator, c("Trait", "Facet"), sep = "_")
}

colnames(nested.strctr$fa[[1]]$loadings) <- paste("MR", c("4", "2", "5", "1", "3"), sep = "_")
colnames(nested.strctr$fa[[2]]$loadings) <- paste("MR", c("4", "3", "1", "5", "2"), sep = "_")
colnames(nested.strctr$fa[[3]]$loadings) <- paste("MR", c("1", "4", "3", "5", "2"), sep = "_")

nested.strctr %>%
  mutate(loadings = map(fa, clean_loadings),
         type = mapvalues(type, unique(type), c("ESM Raw", "ESM Imputed", "Baseline Trait")),
                type = factor(type, levels = c("Baseline Trait", "ESM Raw", "ESM Imputed"))) %>%
  unnest(loadings, .drop = T) %>%
  mutate(Trait = factor(Trait, levels = c("E", "A", "C", "N", "O")))  %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor, y = Facet, fill = abs(loading))) +
      geom_raster() +
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "white", high = "red", limits = c(0,1),
                           breaks = seq(0,1,.5)) +
      geom_text(aes(label = round(loading, 2)), fontface = "bold") +
      labs(x = "EFA-Derived Factors", y = "Putative Factors", fill = "Loading") +
      facet_grid(Trait~type, scales = "free", switch = "y") +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2), color = "black"),
            axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2)),
            legend.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
            legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2)),
            strip.background = element_rect(fill = "black"),
            strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.5), color = "white"),
            strip.placement = "outside",
            legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(sprintf("%s/results/plots/efa_loadings.png", wd), width = 8, height = 8)
```


### Factor Congruence
```{r}
colnames(nested.strctr$fa[[1]]$loadings) <- paste("ESM Raw", c("N", "O", "E", "C", "A"), sep = "_")
colnames(nested.strctr$fa[[2]]$loadings) <- paste("ESM Imputed", c("A", "O", "E", "N", "C"), sep = "_")
colnames(nested.strctr$fa[[3]]$loadings) <- paste("Baseline Trait", c("E", "C", "O", "N", "A"), sep = "_")

cols = cell_spec(
    c("E", "A", "C", "N", "O"), color = "white", bold = T, font_size = 30,
    background = c("darkorange", "goldenrod", "blue", "darkgreen", "purple")
  )

cong <- factor.congruence(nested.strctr$fa)
cong[upper.tri(cong, diag = T)] <- NA
cong %>% data.frame %>%
  rownames_to_column("V1") %>%
  gather(V2, cong, -V1, na.rm = T) %>%
  separate(V1, c("Type1", "Trait1"), sep = "_") %>%
  separate(V2, c("Type2", "Trait2"), sep = "_") %>%
  filter(Type1 != Type2 & Trait1 == Trait2) %>% 
  select(-Trait2) %>%
  mutate(Trait1 = factor(Trait1, levels = c("E", "A", "C", "N", "O")),
         Type2 = str_replace(Type2, "[.]", " ")) %>%
  mutate_at(vars(Type1, Type2), list(~sprintf("<strong>%s</strong>",.))) %>%
  # mutate_at(vars(Type1, Type2), list(~mapvalues(., unique(.), c("ESM Imputed", ""))))
  spread(Trait1, cong) %>%
  kable(., "html", booktabs = T, escape = F,
        col.names = c("", "", cols)) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = F) %>%
  row_spec(c(1,3), background = "lightyellow")
```

## The Personality Space  
```{r}
big5.g <- list(A = 1:3, C = 4:6, E = 7:9, N = 10:12, O = 13:15)
qg <- baseline_facets %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Facet = mapvalues(Facet, short.facets$Facet, short.facets$shrtFacet)) %>% 
    select(-Trait) %>% 
    spread(Facet, t_value) %>%
    select(-SID) %>%
    setNames(paste(rep(c("A", "C", "E", "N", "O"), each = 3), rep(1:3, times = 3), 
        sep = "")) %>%
    cor(., use = "pairwise") %>%
    qgraph(.
           , layout = "circle"
           , edge.color = "black"
           , edge.width = .25
           , label.font = 2
           , label.fill.horizontal = 1
           , label.fill.vertical = 1
           , label.color = "white"
           , border.width = 3
           , groups = big5.g
           , legend = F)

qg$graphAttributes$Nodes$color <- rep(c("darkorange2", "goldenrod2", "blue", "springgreen3", "mediumpurple"), each = 3)
qg$graphAttributes$Nodes$label.color[qg$graphAttributes$Nodes$color %in% c("darkorange2", "goldenrod2")] <- "black"
plot(qg)
```
